task_completion.description: A new tiddler titled 'CTA Line Explorer' is created and open in the wiki.
task_completion.visual_evidence: A tiddler with the exact title 'CTA Line Explorer' visible in the main story river.

task_completion.description: The explorer contains a dropdown menu for selecting train lines.
task_completion.visual_evidence: A visible HTML select/dropdown element within the 'CTA Line Explorer' tiddler.

task_completion.description: The dropdown menu includes Red, Blue, Green, and Brown lines.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The dropdown menu is clicked or expanded, showing 'Red', 'Blue', 'Green', and 'Brown' as selectable options.

task_completion.description: The tiddler displays a total count of stations for the selected line.
task_completion.visual_evidence: A numeric value representing the count of stations updates or appears when a line is selected in the dropdown.

task_completion.description: The tiddler displays a list of clickable links to stations, sorted alphabetically.
task_completion.visual_evidence: A list of blue wiki links (station names) appearing in alphabetical order (e.g., 'Addison' before 'Belmont').

task_completion.description: Stations with ADA accessibility display the text '(ADA)' next to the link.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The text '(ADA)' is visible immediately following specific station links in the list.

integrity.description: The agent used the TiddlyWiki GUI to create and edit the tiddler rather than just modifying files via terminal.
integrity.visual_evidence: Screenshots show the agent clicking the '+' button, typing in the tiddler editor, and clicking the 'tick' save icon.

integrity.description: The list updates dynamically based on dropdown selection, proving it is not a static text list.
integrity.visual_evidence: Screenshots show the station list changing when different lines (e.g., Red vs. Blue) are selected in the dropdown.

integrity.description: The agent used TiddlyWiki widgets (<$list>, <$select>) instead of hardcoding the 15 stations manually.
integrity.visual_evidence: The tiddler in 'edit' mode shows code containing '<$select', '<$list', and '<$count' widgets.

privileged_info_for_vlm: The target tiddler must be titled 'CTA Line Explorer'. The dropdown must specifically support 'Red', 'Blue', 'Green', and 'Brown'. The implementation must use TiddlyWiki widgets: <$select> for the menu, <$count> for the total, and <$list> for the station links. The '(ADA)' text must only appear for stations where the 'ada-accessible' field is 'yes'.
